svg.title: Software factory architecture with proposed Qodo contributions: decisions, evidence plans and release verification
svg.desc: Triage checks intent, risk and eligibility before execution. The work package includes test and production-observation plans. Independent challenge can happen during execution. Release verification assesses health and confirms recovery after repairs. Rules and skills guide delivery and review agents; factory policies govern authorization, including PR auto-approval. Human authority governs delivery and factory improvement. Shared observability links incidents to changes, sessions, retrieved context and environment versions. Failure replay supplies candidate protected reference cases. Memory separates working context, candidate lessons and validated knowledge. Execution and verification environments support delivery, reviewers and factory evaluations. Checker changes require protected evaluation, independent authorization and staged adoption.
svg.text: Qodo overlay: proposed agent, tool and shared-service contributions. Organizational authority stays explicit.

Governed improvement: SWF changes are versioned, independently evaluated and reversible. Authority expands through explicit human decisions.

svg.text: Release protocol; part of Release & observe
Per change: behavior, affected services, health
Healthy: record success. Inconclusive: observe / hold.
Unhealthy: repair, redeploy and verify recovery.
Use risk-based windows, not a timer as proof.
Agent, tool and shared-service integration roles.
Organization retains criteria adoption, permissions and release authority.
